    data = b'{"a": 1}\n{"b": 2}\n{"c": 3}\n'
    f = io.BytesIO(data)
    f.seek(3, os.SEEK_SET)  # inside first line
    it = JSONLIterator.__new__(JSONLIterator)
    it._file_obj = f
    it._blocksize = 4096
    it._align_to_newline()
    # should be at start of second line
    assert f.tell() == 9
    assert f.read() == b'{"b": 2}\n{"c": 3}\n'
